title: The Borrowed Confession
author: Jude Underhill
blurb: Yara Thornbury, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
